messages:
Nikhil: Quick PSA  were hosting an external photo studio for headshots from 3-5pm. They'll bring lighting racks and one big potted fern (they say its for ambiance). Expect 3 visitors + equipment crate.
frontdesk-bot: New visitor pre-reg: Studio Collective  3 guests, ETA 14:50. Preprint badges ready. Reply 'ok' to confirm.
Grace: Fern sounds lovely but we just had a mud/soil package go missing last week  can we keep the plant off carpet and away from the coffee station?
Facilities: We'll reserve Conf D (hardfloor) as staging. Can drop anti-scuff mats and a drip tray. Who will escort?
Tom: I can meet them at the loading bay at 14:45 and wheel the fern + equipment to Conf D. Also there's a package mixup: a "gift basket" scanned for Marketing is actually labeled 'plant soil'  it's in the mailroom. postmaster-bot: Package "Soil Mix" for Marketing arrived 10:12, placed in mailroom shelf B2.
Sofia: Wait, gift basket vs soil? Yikes. I'll swing by and confirm contents. If it's soil, please put on pallet C not in kitchen.
Nikhil: Yeah don't put soil near snacks. frontdesk-bot: Confirmed staging: Conf D 14:45-17:30. Badges: teal visitor lanyards. Escort requested.
Grace: Also heads-up: we have a visiting engineer who needs a hotdesk + monitor for the afternoon. Can someone free up a seat in Dev Bay?
Avery: I can vacate Desk 12 in Dev Bay at 15:00 and move to the phone booth. Desk 12 has a spare monitor cable.
Tom: On the badge/lanyard: please add a small sticker that says "Studio" so security knows they're allowed in Conf D only.
frontdesk-bot: Front desk check-in flow for Studio Collective:
```
1) Ask for pre-reg name or show QR
2) Print teal visitor lanyard + "Studio" sticker
3) Log visitor phone and host (Nikhil)
4) Escort to loading bay -> Conf D (do not pass through kitchen)
5) Note: equipment crate labeled "Fragile - lighting"
```
postmaster-bot: Errand: Someone tagged package "Gift basket" incorrectly. If Marketing doesn't claim by EOD, Facilities to inspect shelf B2 at 16:00.
Sofia: Found the mixup  it's soil, not edible stuff. Moving to pallet C now. Adding a sticky note so front desk doesn't hand it out.
Grace: Thanks. Also, if photographer wants to take snaps of the lobby, please avoid the anniversary plaque wall (family photos).
Nikhil: Noted. I'll brief them. Tom, can you hold the fern until after shoot setup?
Tom: Yep, fern stowed in Conf D on a drip tray and mat. Gear going in next.
Avery: Desk 12 freed at 15:05. Hotdesk available for visiting engineer.
frontdesk-bot: Final reminders: photographer crew to be issued visitor lanyards and escorted at all times. No access to engineering areas.
Grace: Thanks team  and special thanks to Sofia for saving us from surprise potting soil at the snack table :tada:.
